# @yellowcode/mod

The types of `yellowcode/mod`, the API of [YellowCode](https://github.com/ardasarico/YellowCode) mods. It holds no code: YellowCode
gives a mod the API when it loads it. See [Setting up](https://github.com/ardasarico/YellowCode/blob/main/docs/mod-api.md#setting-up).
